prior_heading: We depend on a small number of suppliers for key components.
prior_body:
Practice text, invented for this sheet. We buy most of our sensors from two suppliers.

If either supplier cannot deliver on time, we may be unable to ship products and our revenue could fall.
current_heading: We depend on a small number of suppliers for key components.
current_body:
Practice text, invented for this sheet. We buy most of our sensors from two suppliers, one of which is located in a region exposed to export controls.

If either supplier cannot deliver on time, or new export rules restrict shipments, we may be unable to ship products and our revenue could fall.

prior_heading: Changes in interest rates could increase our borrowing costs.
prior_body: Practice text, invented for this sheet. Our credit facility carries a floating rate. A rise in rates would increase our interest expense and reduce the cash available for investment.
current_heading: Our products may contain defects that harm our reputation.
current_body: Practice text, invented for this sheet. Our software is complex and may contain errors that we find only after release. Defects could lead to recalls, claims from customers and damage to our brand.

prior_heading: We face intense competition in each of our markets.
prior_body: Practice text, invented for this sheet. We compete with larger companies in hardware, software and services. Competitors may cut prices, which could reduce our margins.
current_heading: We face intense competition in our markets.
current_body: Practice text, invented for this sheet. We compete with larger companies in hardware and software. Competitors may cut prices, which could reduce our margins.
